mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 6 months indicates an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 6 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases cost of capital and reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has exceeded 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals labor market strengthening that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime defined by HOUST exceeding 2000 and RSAFS exceeding 350000, rising home construction and consumer credit availability drive corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST > 2000 and RSAFS > 350000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate over the prior 6 months indicates labor market tightening that increases wage pressures and corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has declined over the prior 6 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 110 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has fallen below 110 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in new home construction and consumer credit availability signals robust demand expansion that drives corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST and RSAFS both increase, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime where year-over-year CPI exceeds 3.0%, the Federal Reserve implements restrictive monetary policy that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
